    def replace_expressions(self, replacements):
        if not replacements:
            return self
        if (replacement := replacements.get(self)) is not None:  # Added check for None
            return replacement
        if not (source_expressions := self.get_source_expressions()):
            return self
        clone = self.copy()
        clone.set_source_expressions(
            [
                expr.replace_expressions(replacements) if expr is not None else None  # Added check for None
                for expr in source_expressions
            ]
        )
        return clone
